scope: Local development performance evidence, not a formal soundness proof or official benchmark result.
exclusion_reason: Initial naive fusion smoke used the candidate cwd/source binding for both variants; executable hashes identify the true binaries but this pair is excluded from timing claims.
rule: At least3% paired median improvement in total or all creation, at least6/7 target wins and positive paired bootstrap95% interval, no companion regression over1%, exact key/shape/per-position certificate geometry.
